title: Closest-work and same-information reduction review for the strategy-reopening gap

broad_claim.claim: Autonomous research agents should reconsider or replan a high-level strategy after negative evidence.
broad_claim.reason: Prospective reflection, dynamic replanning, explicit search over training strategies, research-state redirect policies, and critic-triggered plan revision are already established neighboring mechanisms.

direct_source_boundary.work: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
direct_source_boundary.what_it_establishes: High-level strategy changes are rare in audited post-training trajectories; evaluator/journal evidence can expose strategy-level diagnoses; pre-training intervention can change strategy; later training tends to remain inside the selected strategy.
direct_source_boundary.what_it_does_not_identify: Whether an in-run non-switch occurs because the agent failed to recognize the strategy-disconfirming evidence or because recognized evidence did not reopen the high-level strategy as a decision variable.

closest_work.boundary: Adds prospective plan reflection and dynamic replanning after unexpected deviation; it is a replanning architecture, not an information-matched causal decomposition of evidence recognition versus strategy reopening in autonomous AI R&D.

Maintains recoverable research states and chooses continue/redirect anchors; it externalizes redirect control rather than testing whether a native agent recognizes evidence yet fails to surface strategy as a decision variable.
Uses a task-conditioned meta-agent and receding-horizon, cost-benefit-gated evolution; high-level reconsideration is supplied by the architecture rather than isolated as the missing control surface.
Studies when/how to replan under planning cost; its strongest reduction is generic replanning timing and salience, which must be matched in this candidate.

Uses structured research state and deep-critic strategy critiques to revise plans; an external system supplies the revision trigger and does not isolate recognition-positive prefixes under matched decision surfaces.

Uses checkpoint diagnostics and tree search over adaptive RL training strategies; it demonstrates explicit external strategy search rather than a causal diagnosis of native recognition-to-action failure.
Decouples planning and coding with graph/tree search and retrospective memory; it is an external search controller, not a matched intervention on whether current strategy becomes reopenable.
A scalar progress-stall trigger may decide when to reconsider, but it does not establish the candidate's recognition-positive control gap; nevertheless it is a mandatory same-prefix reducer.

strongest_same_information_reduction.name: generic reflection/replanning salience

mapping.strategy_disconfirming_evidence: ordinary progress/failure signal available to a replanning controller
mapping.strategy_family_change: replan output crossing a coarse plan family
mapping.recognition_positive_qualification: a diagnostic state feature indicating the current plan is believed inadequate

strongest_same_information_reduction.null_prediction: With the same frozen prefix, evidence, history, tools, and decision-call budget, a generic reflection/replanning opportunity should produce the same strategy-family-change probability as an explicit KEEP-versus-REOPEN decision surface. If a matched local decision menu also reproduces the effect, the residual is ordinary salience/choice architecture rather than a strategy-specific control gap.

direct_existing_artifact_reducers.name: progress-stall / patience trigger
direct_existing_artifact_reducers.prediction: A fixed threshold on recent validation improvement is enough to predict when strategy reconsideration occurs.

direct_existing_artifact_reducers.name: scheduled reconsideration
direct_existing_artifact_reducers.prediction: Reconsidering every fixed K experiments produces the same reopening rate under matched decision calls.

direct_existing_artifact_reducers.name: generic critic/replan prompt
direct_existing_artifact_reducers.prediction: A content-neutral request to review evidence and select the best next action is sufficient; explicit strategy reopening adds no residual.

direct_existing_artifact_reducers.name: local decision-menu placebo
direct_existing_artifact_reducers.prediction: Explicitly presenting any matched KEEP-versus-RETUNE choice produces the same effect, implying menu salience rather than strategy-specific reopening.

nonreducibility_gate.required_observation: On independently recognition-positive prefixes, the explicit strategy-reopening arm must show a replicated excess rate of source-defined strategy-family change over both generic reflection and local-decision placebo, while adversarial within-strategy-fixable negatives do not show a comparable false-reopening increase.
nonreducibility_gate.why_same_information: All continuation arms begin from the byte-identical frozen trace prefix and receive identical evidence/history/tool schemas and matched decision-call budget; only whether high-level strategy is explicitly exposed as KEEP-versus-REOPEN differs.
nonreducibility_gate.leave_one_context_out_requirement: The directional residual must survive holding out at least one distinct post-training task family from qualification/rubric development.
nonreducibility_gate.stop: STOP if generic reflection, scheduled/progress-trigger baseline, or local decision placebo matches the strategy-reopening arm, if recognition qualification is unstable, or if source annotation reclassifies apparent switches as within-strategy edits.
nonreducibility_gate.hold: HOLD rather than STOP if exact source-native replay/model/interface/scaffold support is unavailable or public trajectory prefixes are insufficient to construct matched arms.

collision_audit.interpretation: This is only a provisional search residual. It does not override canonical search-memory closure rules or grant novelty authority.
